rule: Rule 2: OSM extents are undated; without dated evidence of OSM's age an out-of-band OSM outline gives way to the newest dated licence-OK candidate closer to the facts area, unless a reviewed decision keeps OSM. Keep OSM in inclusive [0.67,1.5]; otherwise choose newest licence-OK candidate, closer to facts area and newer than evidenced OSM extent. Historical inference: IoU >=0.3, historical candidate share >=0.5, IoU advantage >=0.1 over newest candidate. Names AND overlap required (IoU >=0.1 OR candidate share >=0.5).
